title: Where does the game run?
caption: Logical data flows, not finished integration. Streaming sends one game’s media to both players; its current transport uses TURN. Independent clients run the game locally and exchange inputs and checkpoints, without video. The fixture does not restore the original online mode.

routes.label: One host
routes.cost: Clients decode video; host computes the game. Current capture target: 60 FPS.

steps.label: Input
steps.title: Both players send controller input
steps.detail: Each client controls a separate emulated pad port on the same host game. The clients do not execute the game WASM.

steps.label: Compute
steps.title: One host computes the game
steps.detail: The host browser advances the shared game and renders its camera output. A signaling server alone cannot do this work.

steps.label: Stream
steps.title: Send the same picture and sound to both
steps.detail: The host encodes its canvas and audio for both clients. The current transport forces a TURN relay; these arrows show logical endpoints.

steps.label: Display
steps.title: Clients decode and display the stream
steps.detail: Both players see the same game output, including split-screen if the game uses it. Encoding and network delay remain.

routes.label: Independent clients
routes.transport: Input pairs + state checks; no video
routes.cost: Both devices compute the game. Current fixture: 60-Hz lockstep; no rollback.

steps.label: Input
steps.title: Each player supplies an input
steps.detail: Both devices run their own game. Each submits its assigned controller state to the input relay.

steps.label: Pair
steps.title: Distribute the same input pair
steps.detail: Each copy waits for the agreed P1 and P2 input pair before advancing the scheduled gameplay tick. No video is sent.

steps.label: Compute
steps.title: Both devices compute the game locally
steps.detail: The fixture currently renders the original two-player scene on each device. A page crop shows that player’s half.

steps.label: Check
steps.title: Compare state at agreed checkpoints
steps.detail: The relay coordinates state checks. Missing inputs wait; differing hashes stop the current prototype. It has no rollback.
